name: Aion Labs
short: Aion Labs' own serverless inference cloud offering Aion-series models (aion-2.0, aion-3.0, aion-3.0-mini, aion-3.5, aion-3.5-mini, aion-rp-llama-3.1-8b) via an OpenAI-compatible API, with a free developer tier.

plans.name: Free Tier
plans.notes: Instant OpenAI-compatible API key on signup (no credit card required — verbatim on pricing page). Free tier gives a daily credit allowance for agent jobs, API calls, and browser chat. Provider publishes no specific RPM or tokens/day figure.

plans.name: Pay-as-you-go
plans.notes: Prepaid credit balance with higher throughput and no daily token cap. Per-token rates via the API models endpoint: aion-2.0 $0.80/$1.60 per 1M, aion-3.0 $3/$6 per 1M, aion-3.0-mini $0.70/$1.40 per 1M, aion-3.5 $3/$6 per 1M, aion-3.5-mini $0.70/$1.40 per 1M, aion-rp-llama-3.1-8b $0.80/$1.60 per 1M (input/output).

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Monthly invoicing. Usage reconciled at period close with reporting and manual charge workflows. For teams with volume.
